name: Hyperconsciousness
summary: Developer-alpha Rust MCP server for local encrypted, append-only knowledge with scoped, expiring grants.
description:
Hyperconsciousness is an MIT-licensed developer-alpha knowledge engine with a Rust CLI and a local STDIO MCP server. It stores signed, encrypted, append-only records and supports device sync. Grant scopes and expiry control agent access.

Build from source with Rust 1.88 or newer:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness.git
cd hyperconsciousness
git checkout d619a4e59be9c33121389b9cf14e5a93b47b3eb4
cargo build --release --locked
```

Follow the repository README to initialize a store and create a scoped grant. Configure the MCP client to run the absolute path to `target/release/hc` with arguments `["mcp", "--as", "<grant-id>", "--dir", "/absolute/path/to/store"]`. The grant ID and store path must come from your local setup. Add `--write` only when granting capture access.

This entry requires local setup; it does not provide a hosted endpoint. Plaintext returned through MCP is visible to the receiving model or client. See the repository README for the developer-alpha limitations and current setup instructions.
